# `output(entry = page)` naming a window a package-level `for` declares is
# refused, and says why.
#
# hoistForLoopWindowIDs binds that id at package scope as a list<window> -- one
# window per iteration -- so the name answers with as many windows as the loop
# has, and an entry is one window.
#
# Before, the diagnostic said `page is not one`, which is false: it is a window,
# and the objection is that it is several. Resolving it instead would be worse
# than either -- CodegenCtx.EntryWindow matches by name, so a single-model
# target would silently scope to whichever of them the unroll put first.
#
# A CLI fixture rather than a checker one because only internal/build.Check
# resolves an entry: naming a name nobody declared a misspelling takes the whole
# target registry, so TestCheckTestdata never reaches this code.

! sngl check app.sngl
stderr 'which a loop declares once per iteration'

# The same program with the entry named outside the loop is accepted.
sngl check ok.sngl
stdout 'ok'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

output(entry = page) {
    none {
        html
    }
}

const items list<string> = ["a", "b"]

for var it = items {
    window #page(title = it, href = "/" + it + ".html") {
        text(value = page.title)
    }
}

-- ok.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

output(entry = home) {
    none {
        html
    }
}

const items list<string> = ["a", "b"]

window #home(title = "Home", href = "/index.html") {
    text(value = "hi")
}

for var it = items {
    window #page(title = it, href = "/" + it + ".html") {
        text(value = page.title)
    }
}
